subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
13. A garment factory stitches each shirt through a single hand sewing machine
operator. The sewing time required to stitch each shirt is 15 minutes.
Operator is paid at ` 65 per hour. The factory works for 40 hours per week
and the production target is 480 dozens of shirts per week.

What is the number of hours and the number of operators required to meet
the shirts target?
(A)  1,800 Hours & 45 Operators
(B)  1,440 Hours & 36 Operators
(C)  1,800 Hours & 36 Operators
(D)  1,440 Hours & 40 Operators
(2 Marks)
